title: POST /api/auth/logout — invalidate refresh token
description: Implement logout by deleting the refresh token from the database and clearing the cookie.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/auth/logout clears the refresh token cookie
Deletes matching refresh token record from database
Returns 200 even if no cookie was present (idempotent)
Subsequent calls to /api/auth/refresh with old cookie fail

steps.details: 1) Read req.cookies.refreshToken. If present, verify it (ignore errors), find matching token in DB and delete it. 2) Clear the cookie: res.clearCookie('refreshToken', { httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'lax' }). 3) Return 200 { message: 'Logged out' }.
Login, call /api/auth/logout, then try /api/auth/refresh — should return 401. Call logout again (no cookie) — should still return 200.

technicalNotes: Always return 200 from logout regardless of token validity — prevents leaking auth state
